[package]
name = "easy_fuser"
version = "0.6.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "A flexible and idiomatic Fuse implementation for Rust"
license = "MIT"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/easy_fuser"
repository = "https://github.com/Alogani/easy_fuser"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["parallel"]

[features]
default = ["serial", "parallel", "async"]
serial = []
parallel = ["dep:threadpool"]
async = ["dep:async-trait", "dep:tokio"]
deadlock_detection = ["parallel", "dep:parking_lot"]
libfuse = ["fuser/libfuse"]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
libc = "0.2"
bitflags = "2.13"

[dependencies.easy_fuser_macro]
version = "0.1.1"
path = "easy_fuser_macro"

[dependencies.fuser]
version = "0.17.0"

[dependencies.threadpool]
version = "1.8"
optional = true

[dependencies.parking_lot]
version = "0.12"
features = ["deadlock_detection"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.52"
features = ["full"]
optional = true

[dependencies.async-trait]
version = "0.1.89"
optional = true

[dependencies.bimap]
version = "0.6.3"
features = ["std"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3.27"
env_logger = "0.11"

[build-dependencies.askama]
version = "0.16.0"
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "easy_fuser_macro"
version = "0.1.1"
edition = "2024"
description = "Procedural macros for the easy_fuser crate"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/Alogani/easy_fuser"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
quote = "1.0"
proc-macro2 = "1.0"
either = "1.16"

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2.0"
features = ["full"]

[package]
authors = ["Darius C", "Rust-IPFS contributors"]
rust-version = "1.95.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "rust-ipfs"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
description = "IPFS node implementation"
version = "0.16.0"

[features]
default = ["full"]
full = ["stream", "dns", "tls", "noise", "tcp", "quic", "rsa", "ed25519", "secp256k1", "ecdsa", "websocket", "upnp", "pinning", "gateway", "routing"]
rsa = ["connexa/rsa", "rust-ipns/rsa"]
ed25519 = ["connexa/ed25519", "rust-ipns/ed25519"]
secp256k1 = ["connexa/secp256k1", "rust-ipns/secp256k1"]
ecdsa = ["connexa/ecdsa", "rust-ipns/ecdsa"]
stream = ["connexa/stream"]
upnp = ["connexa/upnp"]
dns = ["connexa/dns", "dep:gloo-net"]
tls = ["connexa/tls"]
noise = ["connexa/noise"]
tcp = ["connexa/tcp", "yamux"]
yamux = ["connexa/yamux"]
quic = ["connexa/quic"]
pnet = ["connexa/pnet"]
webrtc = ["connexa/webrtc"]
websocket = ["connexa/websocket"]
webtransport = ["connexa/webtransport"]
pinning = ["dep:reqwest"]
gateway = ["dep:reqwest"]
routing = ["dep:reqwest"]

[workspace]
members = ["packages/*", "unixfs", "examples/*", "misc/*"]
exclude = ["archived"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.100"
async-rt = "0.2.0"
asynchronous-codec = "0.7.0"
bytes = "1.11.1"
cid = "0.11.1"
fs2 = "0.4.3"
futures-timeout = "0.1.3"
futures-timer = "3.0.0"
hickory-resolver = "0.26"
idb = "0.6.4"
indexmap = "2.13.0"
ipld-dagpb = "0.2.2"
multibase = "0.9.2"
multihash = "0.19.3"
multihash-derive = "0.9.1"
parking_lot = "0.12.4"
pollable-map = "0.1.7"
prost = "0.14"
prost-codec = "0.4.0"
other-error = "0.1.1"
rand = "0.9.2"
rlimit = "0.11.0"
rustyline-async = "0.4.6"
send_wrapper = "0.6.0"
serde_ipld_dagcbor = "0.6.3"
serde_ipld_dagjson = "0.2.1"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"
sha2 = "0.10.8"
simple_x509 = "=1.1.0"
web-time = "1.1.0"
zeroize = "1.8.1"

[workspace.dependencies.async-stream]
version = "0.3.6"

[workspace.dependencies.async-trait]
version = "0.1.89"

[workspace.dependencies.base64]
version = "0.22.1"

[workspace.dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[workspace.dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.48"
features = ["derive"]

[workspace.dependencies.connexa]
version = "0.6.0"
features = ["identify", "dcutr", "gossipsub", "autonat", "relay", "kad", "keypair_base64_encoding", "ping", "request-response", "request-response-misc", "rendezvous", "mdns", "fs", "indexeddb"]
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.either]
version = "1.15.0"

[workspace.dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3.31"

[workspace.dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.4.2"

[workspace.dependencies.gloo-net]
version = "0.6"
default-features = false
features = ["http", "json"]

[workspace.dependencies.ipld-core]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["serde"]

[workspace.dependencies.multihash-codetable]
version = "0.2.1"

[workspace.dependencies.quick-protobuf]
version = "0.8.1"

[workspace.dependencies.rcgen]
version = "0.13.2"
features = ["pem", "x509-parser"]

[workspace.dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["json"]

[workspace.dependencies.rust-ipns]
version = "0.9.0"
path = "packages/rust-ipns"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.rust-unixfs]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "unixfs"

[workspace.dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.228"

[workspace.dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"

[workspace.dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.12"

[workspace.dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.41"

[workspace.dependencies.tracing-futures]
features = ["futures-03"]
version = "0.2.5"

[workspace.dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.19"
features = ["env-filter"]

[workspace.dependencies.tokio]
default-features = false
version = "1.52.3"

[workspace.dependencies.tokio-stream]
default-features = false
version = "0.1.18"

[workspace.dependencies.tokio-util]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.18"

[workspace.dependencies.unsigned-varint]
version = "0.8.0"
features = ["asynchronous_codec"]

[workspace.dependencies.wasm-bindgen-futures]
version = "0.4.50"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.100"
async-rt = "0.2.0"
asynchronous-codec = "0.7.0"
bytes = "1.11.1"
futures-timeout = "0.1.3"
indexmap = "2.13.0"
ipld-dagpb = "0.2.2"
multibase = "0.9.2"
multihash = "0.19.3"
multihash-derive = "0.9.1"
parking_lot = "0.12.4"
pollable-map = "0.1.7"
prost-codec = "0.4.0"
prost = "0.14"
rand = "0.9.2"
other-error = "0.1.1"
serde_ipld_dagcbor = "0.6.3"
serde_ipld_dagjson = "0.2.1"
web-time = "1.1.0"
zeroize = "1.8.1"

[dependencies.async-stream]
version = "0.3.6"

[dependencies.async-trait]
version = "0.1.89"

[dependencies.base64]
version = "0.22.1"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[dependencies.connexa]
features = ["cid", "identify", "dcutr", "gossipsub", "autonat", "relay", "kad", "keypair_base64_encoding", "ping", "request-response", "request-response-misc", "rendezvous", "mdns", "fs", "indexeddb"]
version = "0.6.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.either]
version = "1.15.0"

[dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3.31"

[dependencies.ipld-core]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.multihash-codetable]
version = "0.2.1"

[dependencies.rust-ipns]
version = "0.9.0"
path = "packages/rust-ipns"
default-features = false

[dependencies.rust-unixfs]
version = "0.6.0"
path = "unixfs"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.228"

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.12"

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.41"

[dependencies.tracing-futures]
features = ["futures-03"]
version = "0.2.5"

[dependencies.unsigned-varint]
version = "0.8.0"
features = ["asynchronous_codec"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
futures-timer = "3.0.0"
fs2 = "0.4.3"
hickory-resolver = "0.26"
rlimit = "0.11.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.rcgen]
optional = true
version = "0.13.2"
features = ["pem", "x509-parser"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.reqwest]
features = ["rustls-tls", "json"]
optional = true
version = "0.12"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.simple_x509]
optional = true
version = "=1.1.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "1.52.3"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio-stream]
features = ["fs"]
default-features = false
version = "0.1.18"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio-util]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.18"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies]
idb = "0.6.4"
send_wrapper = "0.6.0"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.futures-timer]
features = ["wasm-bindgen"]
version = "3.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
features = ["wasm_js"]
version = "0.4.2"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.gloo-net]
optional = true
version = "0.6"
default-features = false
features = ["http", "json"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.reqwest]
optional = true
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["json"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.tokio]
default-features = false
features = ["sync", "macros"]
version = "1.52.3"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.tokio-stream]
default-features = false
version = "0.1.18"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.tokio-util]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.18"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.wasm-bindgen-futures]
version = "0.4.50"

[dev-dependencies]
rand = "0.9.2"
tempfile = "3.17.1"

[dev-dependencies.hex-literal]
default-features = false
version = "1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "1.52.3"

[dev-dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.19"
features = ["env-filter"]

[profile.dev.build-override]
debug = true

[package]
name = "rust-ipns"
rust-version = "1.88.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
description = "Rust implementation of IPNS"
version = "0.9.0"
authors = ["Darius Clark"]
keywords = ["libp2p", "ipfs"]

[dependencies]
serde_ipld_dagcbor = "0.6.3"
multihash = "0.19.3"
prost = "0.14"

[dependencies.ipld-core]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.bytes]
features = ["serde"]
version = "1.11.1"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.228"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[dependencies.libp2p-identity]
version = "0.3.0"
features = ["peerid", "rand"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
features = ["wasm_js"]
version = "0.4.2"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies.clap]
features = ["derive", "derive"]
version = "4.5.48"

[features]
default = ["rsa", "ed25519", "secp256k1", "ecdsa"]
rsa = ["libp2p-identity/rsa"]
ed25519 = ["libp2p-identity/ed25519"]
secp256k1 = ["libp2p-identity/secp256k1"]
ecdsa = ["libp2p-identity/ecdsa"]

[package]
authors = ["Rust-IPFS contributors"]
description = "UnixFs tree support"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "rust-unixfs"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
version = "0.6.0"

[features]
default = ["filetime"]

[dependencies]
ipld-core = "0.4.3"
ipld-dagpb = "0.2.2"
multihash = "0.19.5"
multihash-derive = "0.9.3"
murmur3 = "=0.5.2"

[dependencies.multihash-codetable]
version = "0.2.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "sha2", "sha3", "blake2b", "blake2s", "blake3"]

[dependencies.either]
default-features = false
version = "1.15.0"

[dependencies.filetime]
optional = true
version = "0.2.29"

[dependencies.quick-protobuf]
version = "0.8.1"

[dependencies.sha2]
default-features = false
version = "0.10.2"

[dev-dependencies.hex-literal]
default-features = false
version = "1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.libc]
default-features = false
version = "0.2.186"

[dev-dependencies.multibase]
default-features = false
version = "0.9.2"

[dev-dependencies.tar]
default-features = false
version = "0.4.46"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
default-features = false
version = "0.8.2"

[[bench]]
name = "ingest-tar"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "adder"
harness = false

[package]
name = "vox"
authors = ["Emil Sayahi <sayahie@miamioh.edu>"]
description = "A performant static site generator built to scale."
repository = "https://github.com/emmyoh/vox/"
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
readme = "README.md"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "vox"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "vox"
path = "src/main.rs"
doc = false
required-features = ["cli"]

[dependencies]
toml = "1.1.3"
liquid = "0.26.11"
liquid-core = "0.26.11"
serde = "1.0.229"
sys-locale = "0.3.2"
latex2mathml = "0.2.3"
thiserror = "2.0.19"
glob = "0.3.4"
futures = "0.3.33"
tracing = "0.1.44"
layout-rs = "0.1.3"
html-escape = "0.2.14"
syntect = "5.3.0"
path-clean = "1.0.1"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.45"
features = ["serde", "unstable-locales"]

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4.6.4"
features = ["derive", "cargo"]
optional = true

[dependencies.comrak]
version = "0.54.0"
features = ["syntect", "shortcodes"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.daggy]
version = "0.9.0"
features = ["stable_dag"]

[dependencies.liquid-lib]
version = "0.26.11"
features = ["all", "stdlib", "jekyll", "shopify", "extra"]

[dependencies.ahash]
version = "0.8.12"
features = ["std", "serde", "runtime-rng"]

[dependencies.mimalloc]
version = "0.1.52"
optional = true

[dependencies.ticky]
version = "1.0.2"

[dependencies.miette]
version = "7.6.0"
features = ["fancy", "syntect-highlighter"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53.1"
features = ["full"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.23"
optional = true
features = ["env-filter"]

[dependencies.notify-debouncer-full]
version = "0.7.0"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.actix-files]
version = "0.6.10"
optional = true

[dependencies.actix-web]
version = "4.14.0"
optional = true

[features]
default = []
cli = ["fs_provider", "dep:mimalloc", "dep:tokio", "dep:clap", "dep:tracing-subscriber", "dep:notify-debouncer-full", "dep:actix-files", "dep:actix-web"]
fs_provider = []
ram_provider = []

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/emmyoh/easy_fuser"]
git = "https://github.com/emmyoh/easy_fuser"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"]
git = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "a1f64c39"

[source."https://github.com/emmyoh/vox"]
git = "https://github.com/emmyoh/vox"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
